drafts_today.topic: Side income from home in my 70s: markets, mini-facials, home parties
drafts_today.text:
Side hustle posts are everywhere this week.

Here's mine, in my 70s on the Sunshine Coast:
A table at the local mall market.
Mini-facials where you apply it yourself while I guide you.
A few home parties with friends.

No get-rich promises. Just real skin, real people, steady work.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your market table set up at Trail Bay or Sunnycrest, products lined up, your hands in frame. 4:5.
